title: What does the padlock guarantee?
instruction: The website has a padlock and https. What does that guarantee you, and what doesn’t it?

items.text: Nobody reads the password on its way to the server
items.why: That is exactly what encryption is for.

items.text: There is an honest company behind the website
items.why: A scammer gets a certificate for free too.

items.text: On public Wi-Fi nobody sees what you type into the form
items.why: On the same network only an encrypted jumble is visible.
A harmful file can be sent encrypted too.

items.text: Nobody changes the data on the way
items.why: Encryption notices if someone tampered with the envelope.

items.text: The website treats your details well
items.why: The padlock has no effect on what the website does with the data once it arrives.

debrief: The padlock protects the route: nobody on it can read or change your data. It says nothing about whether the website is honest.
